in_person.evidence: Pro Se page: 'Pro Se filings are accepted for contested, uncontested, simplified divorce matters, cases to establish paternity, custody, child support, visitation, step-parent adoptions, name changes, modifications, motions, summons, subpoenas, judicial hearings/trials, and general magistrate hearings.' and 'Forms are distributed at a minimal fee by the Clerk of Court.'
in_person.location: Santa Rosa County Court House, 4025 Avalon Blvd., Milton, FL 32583
in_person.applies_to: Pro se filers (self-represented); case types listed on the page

mail.evidence: Contact page lists 'For court related correspondence: 4025 Avalon Blvd, Milton FL, 32583 (Attention: Felony, Misdemeanor, Traffic, Civil, Family Law Dept.)' as a correspondence address. This is a correspondence address, not an explicitly stated filing channel.
mail.note: Phone/email contact alone is not permission to file that way. The correspondence address is not confirmed as a valid filing submission channel.

e_filing.note: Neither page mentions e-filing, electronic filing, or any online filing portal for civil matters.

filing_hours.note: Neither page states operating hours for the filing window.

department_contacts_civil.note: These are department contacts, not judge-specific. Shared office contact Civil@santarosaclerk.com serves multiple departments.

source_date_note: Pages display current date (October 20, 2026) in header but no explicit 'last updated' or effective date for filing policies.
review_scope: Bounded: only the specified pro se information page and one directly-linked contact page. No forms, manuals, e-filing portal pages, or other sources reviewed.

gap_assessment: The two pages reviewed confirm in-person pro se filing is accepted at the courthouse and provide department contacts, but do not state filing hours, e-filing availability, or confirm mail as a filing channel. This is a bounded gap: the specific missing fields (filing hours, e-filing status, mail-filing confirmation) are not present on these two pages and would require additional sources (locations page, e-filing portal, or direct inquiry) to resolve.
